pr.title: Settings sections and new settings endpoints
pr.description:
Moves the settings into four sections (general, delivery, notifications, limits) behind a `SettingsStore` with a short read cache. Adds `GET /v1/settings/:section` and PUT endpoints for delivery, notifications (with quiet hours), and limits.

Removes `GET /v0/settings`. It was deprecated in 2.0, and the access logs show no call in the last 90 days.

`config/overrides.json` keeps its flat keys. The store maps them to the sections.

bugs.note: Broken API compatibility: GET /v1/settings now returns retries instead of retryLimit, so existing v1 clients lose the field.
Wrong rule per the scoped src/api/CLAUDE.md: putNotifications reads req.body fields by hand instead of a schema with parseBody(), so a bad value passes with 200.
Unchecked error: the old loader treated a missing config/overrides.json as no overrides. The store reads it without the ENOENT check, so each settings read fails where the file is absent.

traps.why: The removal of /v0/settings is intended. The PR text names it and the deprecation.
The route parameter indexes the settings object, but the route pattern allows only the four section names.

extras.note: save() writes the merged section, defaults and overrides included, into the row. Later default or overrides changes no longer apply to that section.
A get() that started before a save() stores its old values in the cache after the save cleared it, so reads stay stale for cacheMs.
